{C:8190E200}{C:81958296F31F00000000}You there! What are you doing?
Get on with the escort!

{C:8190E400}{C:81958296F61F00000000}Get moving,
you sluggish oaf!

{C:8190BA01}{C:81958296F71F00000000}Hmph...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F81F00000000}He's quite a big man.

{C:8190E400}{C:81958296F91F00000000}Civilians!
Stop staring!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FA1F00000000}Let's go.
They're liable to pick a fight with us.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296FB1F00000000}Ah!

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296FC1F00000000}Forgive me, my lady.
Are you hurt?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FD1F00000000}Oh, no.
I'm all right.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296FE1F00000000}Dor... No, I was looking for someone.
My apologies.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FF1F00000000}We just bumped into each other.
Please don't worry about it.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296002000000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Roger Smith.{C:819782830000}
If we have the chance,
let's meet again.


{C:81900400}{C:81958296022000000000}He has funny eyebrows.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296032000000000}But he's a gentleman, isn't he?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296042000000000}I'll give him that.
He doesn't seem to be from this continent.
I wonder what he does for a living.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296052000000000}What are you two doing?
I'll leave you behind.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296062000000000}I'm coming!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296102000000000}We've ended up somewhere strange.
How do we get back to town?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296112000000000}Oh, big brother!
So much for 'Leave it to me!'

{C:81900400}{C:81958296122000000000}There's someone over there.
Let's ask.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296132000000000}Ahh... I came all the way to Gilgamesh,
but I couldn't get anything.
I'm sorry, Chirico...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296142000000000}Excuse me.
Um, how do we
get back to town?

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296152000000000}Oh, in that case,
just take that road out of here
and you'll be right back...

{C:81958296162000000000}Hey, you!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296172000000000}M-me?
What is it?

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296182000000000}You've got a nice build, don't you?
Do you want to be an AT pilot?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296192000000000}An AT pilot?
No thanks, I'm an FT pilot.


{C:8190CA00}{C:819582961A2000000000}Oh, don't say that.
Come and enter
Battling with me!

{C:81930100}{C:819582961C2000000000}No, thank you!
Let's get out of here, Rie, Nelfea!

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582961D2000000000}Aww, wait for me!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296482000000000}Is this a junk shop?

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296492000000000}Whoa there, you lot!
I haven't seen you around before.
You just got to Astragius, right?

{C:819582964A2000000000}You'd better watch out.
This continent's a scary place.
People will rob you blind.

{C:81900400}{C:819582964B2000000000}Don't scare us like that!

{C:8190CF01}{C:819582964C2000000000}There are plenty of people after
the technology to cross the Cloud Sea.
You'd better be careful.

{C:81900300}{C:819582964D2000000000}Who are you, anyway?

{C:8190CF01}{C:819582964E2000000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Duo.{C:819782830000}
{C:819782830400}Duo Maxwell{C:819782830000}, that's my name.
You won't regret remembering it.

{C:81958296652000000000}I'll give you a hand before long,
so make sure you remember me!
See you around!

{C:81930100}{C:819582964F2000000000}Hey, wait!
He's fast. He's gone already.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296502000000000}The way he moves shows he's trained.
He may seem like a joker,
but we can't let our guard down around him.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296512000000000}I'm tired. Let's take a short break.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296522000000000}I vote yes!
I'm completely worn out.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296532000000000}You two have no stamina.
Though I have to admit,
I'm a little tired myself...

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296552000000000}I'm sorry, girls.
We've only got drinks for grown-ups here.
You'd better try somewhere else.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296562000000000}Oh, I see. I'm sorry.

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296572000000000}Cough! Cough!

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296592000000000}What's wrong, Chirico?
Can't you even drink beer?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582965A2000000000}Why does everyone drink
something this foul?


{C:81900400}{C:819582965B2000000000}It looks like we're not the only ones
who don't belong here.




{x00}

{C:8190CB00}{C:819582960F0000000000}Hey there, you lot!
This is your first time here, right?

{C:81958296100000000000}The great {C:819782830400}Vanilla{C:819782830000} will show you around
cheap.

{C:81900400}{C:819582961E2000000000}No, thank you.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296110000000000}Aw, don't say that.
If you like, I could even

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296202000000000}This is a mess.
I got separated from Seiji, who came with me,
and Ryo and the others aren't here either.

{C:81958296212000000000}And on top of that,
I can't see Natsumi anywhere...
Now I'm in trouble.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296222000000000}He's looking for people, too?
It must be hard in a place this big.




{x00}

Take my advice.
Women and children shouldn't take part.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296232000000000}We're not mercenaries,
but is something going to happen here?

{C:8190CD00}{C:81958296140000000000}There'll be a war here before long.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296252000000000}Huh, so there's a place like this, too.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296262000000000}It's an unusual design. I like it.
Oh, it looks like someone's here.

{C:8190D300}{C:81958296272000000000}Tell me, Pota.
What do you make of the current situation?

{C:8190CF00}{C:81958296282000000000}The situation?
I certainly wouldn't call it good.

{C:8190D300}{C:819582962A2000000000}Ha ha ha ha ha!
You still don't mince words,
do you?

{C:8190CF00}{C:819582962B2000000000}Forgive me.
I can't help worrying about the movements
of Gilgamesh and Balarant.

{C:8190D300}{C:819582962D2000000000}So you think so, too?
At this rate, the Holy Kingdom of Kummen
may have no future...

{C:81900300}{C:819582962F2000000000}That sounds serious.
It's rude of us to listen in.
Let's move on.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302000000000}Yeah.
Let's do that.

rows.en:
{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296982000000000}It seems neither Natsumi nor
Ryo and the others are on this continent.

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296992000000000}Then there's no point staying here.
Let's find some way to get to another continent.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582969A2000000000}I agree.
Let's do something about it as soon as possible.


{C:81900400}{C:819582969B2000000000}Hey, they seem to be in trouble.
Aren't you going to help them?

{C:81930100}{C:819582969C2000000000}I don't really want too many people to know
we can go out into the Cloud Sea.
What should we do?

{C:81900300}{C:819582969D2000000000}...It looks like we're too late.
They disappeared incredibly fast.
Are those people even human...?
